raw_segments.text: Oh, no need to apologize. I consider that when a dependent does her duty as well as
you have done yours, she has a sort of claim upon her employer for any little assistance
he can conveniently render her. Indeed, I have already, through my future mother-in-law,
heard of a place that I think will suit. It is to undertake the education of the five
daughters of Mrs. Dionysius Ogall of Bitternut Lodge, Connaught, Ireland. You'll like Ireland,
I think. They're such warm-hearted people there, they say.
